text:
Maya: Quick heads-up  AWS Marketplace co-launch with NovaEdge (SI) incoming. Need a pragmatic, audit-friendly lead ownership flow for marketplace-origin leads + SI intros.
Lina: +1. We should avoid manual ping-pong. Proposed goal: deterministic auto-stamping for 80% of cases, manual review for exceptions.
Raj: Agree. Important to protect active deals and Redwood named accounts.
Noah: Draft rules from my side: priority signals are (a) explicit partner intro (email or portal) with `partner:novaedge-intro` tag, (b) marketplace-origin + partner claimed in intake queue, (c) deal value threshold >= $150k or strategic account flag.
Maya: Question: do we treat an email intro equal to a partner portal referral? I vote yes if the intro includes a partner rep and prospective meeting is scheduled.
Lina: Yes. Must have meeting link or transcript evidence. Also add TTL: if partner intro tag exists but no meeting within 21 days, auto-expire and revert owner to Redwood.
Raj: Good. Also add shadow-owner concept: when Nova owns, Redwood keeps a shadow owner (ops contact) for coordination and for NAMED accounts the shadow-owner acts as veto.
Noah: Implementation sketch for automation engine:
```
// run on lead creation or update
if has_tag('partner:novaedge-intro') and meeting_exists_with_partner_within(21d):
  if account.named == true: require_sales_exec_approval()
  owner = NovaEdge
  set_shadow_owner = RedwoodOps
else if lead_source contains 'aws_marketplace' and partner_claimed == true:
  owner = NovaEdge
else if ARR >= 150000 and not in_stage(['proposal','contract']):
  owner = NovaEdge
else:
  owner = Redwood
// TTL: if partner tag expired -> unassign after 21d of no activity
```
Sarah-W: Dispute and escalation ladder idea: 1) file `dispute:open` on record + post to #partnerships-disputes, 2) 12hr SLA for comments, 3) if still unresolved escalate to partnership manager + sales lead with 48hr kill-switch. Keep an audit trail in CRM chatter.
Maya: We also need a handoff badge in the intake UI: small banner showing current owner, shadow owner, and how the ownership was selected (rule id). Helps reduce churn.
Lina: Excellent. For GTM/press accounts: manual triage only, require GTM + legal sign-off before assignment.
Raj: SFDC mapping: create custom fields `partner_intro_source`, `partner_claimed`, `ownership_reason`, `dispute_status`, `shadow_owner`. Partnerships-bot should populate `ownership_reason` and post links to the lead in #partnerships-ops.
partnerships-bot: noted  will push ownership updates, disputes, and expiring tags to #partnerships-ops and set CRM fields via API. :robot_face:
Noah: Engineering asks: expose intake webhook param `utm_source`, add `partner_claimed_by` string, and emit `owner_change` webhook events. Also please add an audit log for automatic owner flips.
Maya: Ops ask: add standardized email intro template that sets the `partner:novaedge-intro` tag when sent by the partner. We'll add instructions to the partner portal.
Lina: Timeline: intake API changes + SFDC fields by Wed, UI badge + automation rules in staging by next Wed, pilot for the first 2 weeks of the launch. Ops playbook owner?
Sarah-W: I'll own the playbook and run the weekly handoff review for disputes during pilot.
Maya: I'll coordinate partner-facing docs and the email template.
Raj: I'll sync with NovaEdge on triage SLA and confirm their intake queue process.
Lina: If no objections we'll lock these rules and pilot. Anyone object?
Noah: No objections from eng. ready to build.
Sarah-W: Good to pilot.
Maya: All clear.
Lina: Locked 389 I'll add the final playbook link and PR references when ready.
